table activities
  column created_at type=INTEGER notnull=0 default=strftime('%s', 'now') pk=0
  column distance_meters type=REAL notnull=0 default=<none> pk=0
  column duration_secs type=INTEGER notnull=0 default=<none> pk=0
  column id type=TEXT notnull=0 default=<none> pk=1
  column max_lat type=REAL notnull=1 default=<none> pk=0
  column max_lng type=REAL notnull=1 default=<none> pk=0
  column min_lat type=REAL notnull=1 default=<none> pk=0
  column min_lng type=REAL notnull=1 default=<none> pk=0
  column name type=TEXT notnull=0 default=<none> pk=0
  column sport_type type=TEXT notnull=1 default=<none> pk=0
  column start_date type=INTEGER notnull=0 default=<none> pk=0
  index idx_activities_bounds unique=0 origin=c partial=0 cols=[min_lat,max_lat,min_lng,max_lng]
  index idx_activities_sport unique=0 origin=c partial=0 cols=[sport_type]
  index auto(id) unique=1 origin=pk partial=0 cols=[id]

table section_activities
  column activity_id type=TEXT notnull=1 default=<none> pk=2
  column avg_hr type=REAL notnull=0 default=<none> pk=0
  column direction type=TEXT notnull=1 default='same' pk=0
  column distance_meters type=REAL notnull=1 default=0 pk=0
  column end_index type=INTEGER notnull=1 default=0 pk=0
  column excluded type=INTEGER notnull=1 default=0 pk=0
  column lap_pace type=REAL notnull=0 default=<none> pk=0
  column lap_time type=REAL notnull=0 default=<none> pk=0
  column section_id type=TEXT notnull=1 default=<none> pk=1
  column start_index type=INTEGER notnull=1 default=0 pk=3
  index idx_section_activities_activity unique=0 origin=c partial=0 cols=[activity_id]
  index idx_section_activities_perf unique=0 origin=c partial=0 cols=[section_id,excluded,lap_time]
  index auto(section_id,activity_id,start_index) unique=1 origin=pk partial=0 cols=[section_id,activity_id,start_index]
  fk activity_id -> activities.id on_update=NO ACTION on_delete=CASCADE
  fk section_id -> sections.id on_update=NO ACTION on_delete=CASCADE

index idx_activities_bounds :: CREATE INDEX idx_activities_bounds ON activities(min_lat, max_lat, min_lng, max_lng)
index idx_activities_sport :: CREATE INDEX idx_activities_sport ON activities(sport_type)
index idx_activity_bodies_date :: CREATE INDEX idx_activity_bodies_date ON activity_bodies(date DESC)
index idx_activity_indicators_activity :: CREATE INDEX idx_activity_indicators_activity ON activity_indicators(activity_id)
index idx_activity_indicators_target :: CREATE INDEX idx_activity_indicators_target ON activity_indicators(target_id)
index idx_activity_matches_route :: CREATE INDEX idx_activity_matches_route ON activity_matches(route_id)
index idx_activity_metrics_sport_date :: CREATE INDEX idx_activity_metrics_sport_date ON activity_metrics(sport_type, date DESC)
index idx_calendar_event_bodies_date :: CREATE INDEX idx_calendar_event_bodies_date ON calendar_event_bodies(date)
index idx_exercise_sets_activity :: CREATE INDEX idx_exercise_sets_activity ON exercise_sets(activity_id)
index idx_ftp_history_date :: CREATE INDEX idx_ftp_history_date ON ftp_history(date DESC)
index idx_groups_sport :: CREATE INDEX idx_groups_sport ON route_groups(sport_type)
index idx_heatmap_date :: CREATE INDEX idx_heatmap_date ON activity_heatmap(date)
index idx_overlap_cache_a :: CREATE INDEX idx_overlap_cache_a ON overlap_cache(activity_a)
index idx_overlap_cache_b :: CREATE INDEX idx_overlap_cache_b ON overlap_cache(activity_b)
index idx_pace_history_sport_date :: CREATE INDEX idx_pace_history_sport_date ON pace_history(sport_type, date DESC)
index idx_section_activities_activity :: CREATE INDEX idx_section_activities_activity ON section_activities(activity_id)
index idx_section_activities_perf :: CREATE INDEX idx_section_activities_perf ON section_activities(section_id, excluded, lap_time)
index idx_section_history_section :: CREATE INDEX idx_section_history_section ON section_history(section_id, at)
index idx_sections_disabled :: CREATE INDEX idx_sections_disabled ON sections(disabled)
index idx_sections_sport :: CREATE INDEX idx_sections_sport ON sections(sport_type)
index idx_sections_superseded :: CREATE INDEX idx_sections_superseded ON sections(superseded_by)
index idx_sections_type :: CREATE INDEX idx_sections_type ON sections(section_type)
index idx_stream_bodies_updated :: CREATE INDEX idx_stream_bodies_updated ON stream_bodies(updated_at)
index idx_wellness_date_desc :: CREATE INDEX idx_wellness_date_desc ON wellness(date DESC)
trigger section_activities_visit_count_ad :: CREATE TRIGGER section_activities_visit_count_ad AFTER DELETE ON section_activities BEGIN UPDATE sections SET visit_count =(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM section_activities WHERE section_id = OLD.section_id AND excluded = 0) WHERE id = OLD.section_id; END
trigger section_activities_visit_count_ai :: CREATE TRIGGER section_activities_visit_count_ai AFTER INSERT ON section_activities BEGIN UPDATE sections SET visit_count =(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM section_activities WHERE section_id = NEW.section_id AND excluded = 0) WHERE id = NEW.section_id; END
trigger section_activities_visit_count_amove :: CREATE TRIGGER section_activities_visit_count_amove AFTER UPDATE OF section_id ON section_activities BEGIN UPDATE sections SET visit_count =(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM section_activities WHERE section_id = NEW.section_id AND excluded = 0) WHERE id = NEW.section_id; UPDATE sections SET visit_count =(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM section_activities WHERE section_id = OLD.section_id AND excluded = 0) WHERE id = OLD.section_id; END
trigger section_activities_visit_count_au :: CREATE TRIGGER section_activities_visit_count_au AFTER UPDATE OF excluded ON section_activities BEGIN UPDATE sections SET visit_count =(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM section_activities WHERE section_id = NEW.section_id AND excluded = 0) WHERE id = NEW.section_id; END
